notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the game takes too long to open
 Fixed an issue where Steam is still running the game even after you closed the game application
 Added a recipe - Strawberry Matcha Milk

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the game would get stuck if drinks were served too quickly in a certain scenario.
Fixed a bug where the NPC would not proceed in a certain scenario.

notes.title: Minor fix
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where some players were unable to see resolution options in the dropdown due to it only displaying resolutions with a specific refresh rate.

The resolution dropdown will now display all refresh rates along with the screen resolutions supported by your monitor.
